about_the_game:
Farm the Past. Rewrite the Future.

In Project Starfall, players take the role of a government scientist sent to revive a remote farm—but nothing is as it seems. With a time-traveling truck and an alien crop at your fingertips, you’ll jump between the 1940s, 1960s, and 1980s to uncover a cosmic mystery that spans generations.

A Time-Twisting Farming Sim

  • Grow and harvest crops tailored to each era’s climate, soil, and technology.

  • Rebuild your farm from the ground up—then see how your changes echo across time.

  • Extract time fuel from a mysterious alien plant to unlock era-jumping powers.

  • Interact with a quirky cast of NPCs, each shaped by the decade they live in—and by the history you create.

  • Explore an evolving world full of secrets, collectibles, and story events that shift as the timeline branches.

An Unforgettable Cast

  • Colonel Striker – A war hero with a buried agenda.

  • SweetStar – A cosmic-minded hippie who senses shifts in reality.

  • Sterling – A slick tycoon chasing profit across timelines.

Three Eras, One Farm

🪖 The 40s – Wartime duty and buried secrets
🌼 The 60s – Rebellion, flower power, and strange new energy
💾 The 80s – Neon, greed, and fractured timelines

Shape the Timeline

  • Rebuild and upgrade your farm to see changes ripple across decades.

  • Solve era-spanning puzzles where actions in one time unlock paths in another.

  • Manage shipments and resources in a shifting world economy.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Catalina (10.15) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or newer) OR Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 555X (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Monterey 12+
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 / M3 chip or Intel Core i7 (8th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2/M3 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: A narrative farming sim with time travel mechanics. Grow crops across three distinct eras, extract time fuel from an alien plant, and rebuild your farm as history changes around you. Explore, trade, and alter the future through decisions made in the past.
